name: Heart-shaped tea hills
kicker: Contour tea rows above Tan Lap
summary: Walk the contour tea rows at Tan Lap, the hills that read as a heart from above. The wider ground is about 3,000 ha, and also more than 3,000 ha. One account calls it the largest tea region in Vietnam. Another says the tea is less famous than Thai Nguyen tea. A 2019 note of free entry is not the fee now. Do not sit on the bushes.
getThere: From the farm town toward Tan Lap. The 2019 turns are old.
heroCaption: Contour tea, a path, and the ridge in the late light

notice.title: Do not sit on the bushes
notice.body: Visitors are asked not to sit or lie on the tea. A 2019 free-entry line is not the fee now. Check the gate on arrival.

body: Walk the contour rows at Tan Lap. From above, some of the hills read as a heart. What you walk through is the rows, the path, and the peak. At least three hills are named. The turns from 2019 are old. Check them on arrival.
The wider tea ground is about 3,000 ha, and also more than 3,000 ha. One account calls it the largest tea region in Vietnam. Another says the tea is less famous than Thai Nguyen tea.
A 2019 note of free entry is not the fee now. The fee, the hours, and how long the walk takes are check on arrival.

figures.caption: The same rows in the morning, with the peak and a path
figures.alt: Green contour tea rows, a bare tree, and a peak above Tan Lap in the morning

gettingThere: The hills are at Tan Lap, reached from the farm town. A 26 Dec 2019 route set is now old: about 7 km toward Tan Lap then 500 m for one hill, a longer continuation for the processing ground, and about 5 km plus 3 km for a farm-town hill that was due to open in early 2020. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the farm town
legs.body: Road toward Tan Lap. The 2019 distances are about 7 km then 500 m, a longer continuation toward the processing ground, or about 5 km plus 3 km for the farm-town hill. Those turns are old. Check them and the minutes on arrival.

admissionNote: A 2019 note of free entry is not the fee now. Check on arrival.
